This fixture demonstrates a simple numerical interpolation setup.

Part A

The nodes are defined by $x_i = 0.2 + 0.08i$.
f(x)=11+25x2f(x)=\frac{1}{1+25x^2}f(x)=1+25x21​

matlab
x=0:0.1:1; y=1./(1+25*x.^2); plot(x,y);

Part B

The interpolation polynomial is represented by $p_4(x)$.

matlab
p=polyfit(x,y,4); disp(p);
